title: Minimum Sum Of Mountain Triplets II
statement:
A mountain triplet consists of indices `i < j < k` with `nums[i] < nums[j]` and `nums[k] < nums[j]`. Return the minimum sum of any mountain triplet, or `-1` if none exists.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums = [8, 6, 1, 5, 3]
Output: 9
```

```text
Input: nums = [5, 4, 8, 7, 10, 2]
Output: 13
```

```text
Input: nums = [6, 5, 4, 3, 4, 5]
Output: -1
```

## Constraints

- `3 <= nums.length <= 10^5`
- `1 <= nums[i] <= 10^8`
